title: A note on the Kolmogorov-type inequalities for more than three norms
summary: In this note we show that sharp Kolmogorov-type inequalities that estimate the uniform norm $\|f^{(k)}\|$ of the $k$-th derivative of a function $f\colon \mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ by the values of the uniform norm of $f$ and uniform norms of several its higher derivatives ($\|f^{(r)}\|$ and $\|f^{(r-1)}\|$, or $\|f^{(r)}\|$ and $\|f^{(r-2)}\|$, or $\|f^{(r)}\|$, $\|f^{(r-1)}\|$ and $\|f^{(r-2)}\|$) using standard techniques can be obtained from the known solutions to the Kolmogorov problem about existence of a function with given norms of its derivatives.
